title: Micro Operational Robustness of LLMs on Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28957v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: It is now common practice in software development for large language models (LLMs) to be used to generate program code. It is desirable to evaluate the robustness of LLMs for this usage. This paper is concerned in particular with how sensitive LLMs are to variations in descriptions of the coding tasks. However, existing techniques for evaluating this robustness are unsuitable for code generation because the input data space of natural language (NL) descriptions is discrete and sparse. To address this problem, we propose a robustness evaluation method called scenario domain analysis, which aims to find the expected minimal change in the NL descriptions of coding tasks that would cause the LLMs to produce incorrect outputs. translated_title: 大语言模型在代码生成中的微观操作鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 如今在软件开发中，使用大语言模型（LLM）生成程序代码已成为常见做法，因此评估LLM在这一用途中的鲁棒性十分必要。本文特别关注LLM对编码任务描述变化的敏感程度。然而，现有的鲁棒性评估技术并不适用于代码生成，因为自然语言（NL）描述的输入数据空间是离散且稀疏的。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种称为“场景域分析”的鲁棒性评估方法，旨在找到编码任务的自然语言描述中会导致LLM产生错误输出的预期最小变化。我们从理论上正式证明了该方法的理论性质，并开展了大量实验来评估四种最先进的大语言模型（Gemini-pro、Codex、Llama2和Falcon 7B）的鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“场景域分析”的鲁棒性评估方法，通过寻找编码任务自然语言描述中导致大语言模型输出错误结果的最小变化，来系统评估LLM在代码生成任务中的微观操作鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a robustness evaluation method called scenario domain analysis, which identifies the expected minimal change in natural language descriptions of coding tasks that causes LLMs to produce incorrect outputs, thereby evaluating the micro operational robustness of LLMs in code generation.
